title: Substitution for Member at Kachin State Investment Committee
text:
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myanmar Investment Commission
Notification No. 23/ 2021
nd
2 Waning of Pyatho 1382 ME
(29 January 2021)
Substitution for Member at Kachin State Investment Committee
U Khin Maung Lay, Secretary of Kachin State Government has been appointed as
the member of Kachin State Investment Committee which was formed by the
Notification No. 48/ 2017 of the Myanmar Investment Commission.
(Thaung Tun)
Chairman
